title: HTTPResponse
description: HTTP data archetype — HTTP response message classification. Rootless (no GSM base extension). Types the data payload flowing through Effector/Receptor ports when the payload is an HTTP response message. Source: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics, 2022), §3.4 — Messages, §15 — Status Codes.

statusClass.description: HTTP response status class (first digit of the status code). INFORMATIONAL — 1xx, interim response (§15.2). SUCCESSFUL — 2xx, request successfully received, understood, and accepted (§15.3). REDIRECTION — 3xx, further action needed to complete the request (§15.4). CLIENT_ERROR — 4xx, request contains bad syntax or cannot be fulfilled (§15.5). SERVER_ERROR — 5xx, server failed to fulfill an apparently valid request (§15.6). Source: RFC 9110 §15 — Status Codes.

contentType.description: Media type of the response payload body (IANA media type). Source: RFC 9110 §8.3 — Content-Type.
